entwurf.thema: Claude Code: no REA GitHub source, but a documented setup for paid projects

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Your deploy process lives only in your head. Claude Code can't see it. That's a nightmare for paid projects.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: black-haired man in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits tense in a dim home office at night, hand on his forehead, medium shot, cool neon light.

teile.name: Blind spots
teile.text: But that's not the only blind spot. Team meeting decisions and the environment variable your tests need stay invisible too.
teile.szene: Painted urban game style: a team meeting seen through a glass wall, one person gesturing while others listen, the cyan-glasses presenter watching from the corridor, wide shot, warm evening light.

teile.name: Rediscovery
teile.text: Facts sit in the repo, but take digging. Claude redoes that digging at the start of every session.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket leans over a desk, frustrated, repeating the same hunt through stacked folders, close-medium shot, desk lamp light.

teile.name: The test
teile.text: So what goes in? Only what Claude can't find. Ask: could it find this by reading the code?
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style: the presenter in black leather jacket and cyan glasses writes short notes by hand at a cluttered desk, a spark of realization on his face, close shot, lamp light, calm space above and below.

teile.name: Hypothetical use
teile.text: Hypothetically, a freelancer writes down the client's deploy steps. Rules that can't bend become hooks, enforced every time.
teile.szene: Painted open-world style: the cyan-glasses presenter on a call with a client, jotting steps on a notepad in a small apartment studio, medium shot, soft window light.

teile.name: Payoff
teile.text: That's a small amount of setup. Now the deploy process from your head is something Claude can see.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style: the presenter in leather jacket and cyan glasses leans back calmly in a tidy home office, relieved expression, medium shot, warm lamp glow.

teile.name: Abschluss
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: the black-haired presenter in leather jacket and cyan glasses smiles and gives a thumbs-up beside a closed laptop, medium shot, golden evening light.

entwurf.beschreibung: Anthropic's Claude Code docs advise writing down only what Claude can't find by reading your code, like undocumented deploy steps or a test environment variable. Rules that must always apply belong in hooks.
